name: What are the first steps to plan a bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: What are the first steps to plan a bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Starting a bathroom renovation involves several key steps. First, define your needs and desired style, considering functionality, accessibility, and aesthetics. Next, establish a realistic budget, accounting for materials, labor, and a contingency fund. Research and gather inspiration to create a clear vision. Then, schedule consultations with reputable contractors to discuss your ideas, obtain estimates, and review their portfolio. Finally, finalize your design choices and sign a contract before construction begins. A well-planned project ensures a smoother renovation experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Begin by defining your needs and style, setting a budget, and gathering inspiration. Then, consult contractors for estimates, finalize your design, and sign a contract.
